name: guess-my-name
description: Madame Mystique's Crystal Ball - a name-guessing quiz with browser and CI-trained models
//: There are no runtime dependencies. The site is static files, and the browser
loads @tensorflow/tfjs from a CDN (pinned in src/index.html) rather than npm.
@tensorflow/tfjs-node is a devDependency because only scripts/train-model.js
uses it, and that runs in GitHub Actions. Its audit findings all come from
@mapbox/node-pre-gyp, the installer that fetches its native binary; none of
that reaches a visitor. `npm run audit:prod` is the number that matters.
Keep the CDN version in src/index.html in step with the tfjs-node major/minor
below: one writes the model format and the other reads it.
